newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs seen well bid ahead of Amsterdam EMU weekend.
newsitem.headline: OLOs seen well bid ahead of Amsterdam EMU weekend.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds held on to early gains at the close on Wednesday, but the market remained largely directionless, watching the European war of words on EMU and awaiting U.S. economic indicators, dealers said.

Following jitters at the start of the week about France's insistence that the EMU stability pact also focused on jobs, the message the market traded on on Wednesday was that EU leaders would find a compromise which would not jeopardise the single currency project in time for next week's Amsterdam summit.
"It looks like a satisfying deal will be found on the stability pact," one dealer at a French-owned bank said.
